Bug_Details:
Category: Perf regression. Reported as "Annotation Reachability Error" by annotation-reachability.

A method annotated with an annotation @A transitively calls a method annotated @B where the combination of annotations is forbidden (for example, @UiThread calling @WorkerThread).
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs because the method updateUI is annotated with @UiThread and calls performBackgroundTask annotated with @WorkerThread. This combination is invalid as a UI thread method should not call a worker thread method directly.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the method showBug, which in turn calls the updateUI method annotated with @UiThread. The updateUI method calls performBackgroundTask annotated with @WorkerThread. This forbidden combination of annotations triggers the annotation reachability error.
